context: An elderly couple reminisces about culture
purpose: Teach: 源氏/馬鹿げ/ジャクソン/ニコン/シャレ/一直線/勇者/苔

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、源氏物語の原文、読んだな。
lines.en: I read the original Genji Tale when I was young.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Soft nostalgic gaze into distance. Pause after 'young' — letting the memory settle. Quiet, unhurried, like he's turning the pages of the book in his mind.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。馬鹿げた喧嘩、二人で笑った後、よく仲直りしたわね。
lines.en: Yes. We'd have silly little fights, laugh about them afterwards, and then make up just like that.
lines.style: Warm reminiscence with a smile underneath. Rhythmic, conversational pace. Slight lift on 'laugh' — the memory is genuinely affectionate. Trailing off gently on 'make up' like she can see it happening again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: マイケル・ジャクソン、若い頃のアイドルだった。
lines.en: Michael Jackson was my idol when I was young.
lines.style: Quiet, slightly amazed tone — as if surprised by how clearly he remembers it. Gentle emphasis on 'was,' not defensive but accepting of time's passage. Soft, almost dreamlike delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: カメラはニコン派、ずっと使ってきたわね。
lines.en: I've always been loyal to Nikon cameras — used them for decades.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact affection. Steady, assured tone — this is something she knew about herself. Small smile in her voice, not showy. Casual precision, like mentioning a faithful friend.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 結婚式の写真、シャレた構図で撮ってもらった。
lines.en: The wedding photos came out so beautifully composed.
lines.style: Soft, satisfied recollection. Gentle emphasis on 'beautifully' — not bragging, just pleased. Takes a beat, as if he's looking at the photos in his mind. Warm, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 帰宅、いつも一直線、寄り道少ない人だったわね。
lines.en: He'd come straight home after work — always was the type who didn't dawdle.
lines.style: Wry fondness, very slight edge of teasing affection. Conversational rhythm like she's explaining a well-known habit to someone who'd appreciate the joke. Light and knowing, not unkind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 子供たち、勇者ごっこ、よくやってた。
lines.en: The kids used to play pretend hero games all the time.
lines.style: Soft, watching tone — like he's seeing them at play. Voice carries the gentleness of watching children lost in their own worlds. Slight smile. Nostalgic but not sad, just tender memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 庭の苔、若い頃から、丁寧に手入れしてきたわ。
lines.en: The moss in our garden — I've tended it carefully since we were young.
lines.style: Warm, intimate closing. Quiet pride in the work without boasting. Slight pause before 'carefully,' emphasizing the care itself. Voice softens on the final words, like a hand smoothing over something cherished. Final words almost a whisper.
